prompt: Create a cinematic stylized scene of a friendly-looking monster hiding behind a wall about to scare a kid. The kid is walking by unaware. Make it spooky, polished, readable, and not gory. Do not use text labels unless they help the composition.

scene_plan.title: Friendly Monster Peekaboo
scene_plan.prompt: Create a cinematic stylized scene of a friendly-looking monster hiding behind a wall about to scare a kid. The kid is walking by unaware. Make it spooky, polished, readable, and not gory. Do not use text labels unless they help the composition.

scene_intent.read: clear visual storytelling with immediate emotional contrast
scene_intent.cinematic_goal: build tension through composition and timing, resolve with a playful jump-scare

composition.layout: rule of thirds with monster in left third, kid moving through right third
composition.negative_space: open hallway space to emphasize isolation and impending surprise

camera.framing: medium wide shot, kid entering from right, monster partially visible behind left wall
camera.angle: slightly low angle to make monster loom slightly

environment.atmosphere: dim ambient light with subtle volumetric dust

subjects.pose: crouched behind wall, one eye and hand visible, body coiled to spring
subjects.expression: playful grin, eyes wide with anticipation
subjects.color_hint: soft blue fur with lighter belly, dark blue claws
subjects.material_notes: fuzzy subsurface scattering for fur, glossy wet nose, matte claws
subjects.animation: holds pose until beat 2, then lunges forward on beat 3

subjects.pose: mid-stride, head slightly down, arms swinging casually
subjects.color_hint: bright yellow raincoat, blue jeans, brown boots
subjects.animation: walks left to right across frame from beat 1 to beat 3

objects.material_notes: matches wall plaster, slight edge wear

objects.purpose: practical light source casting soft glow

lighting.key: soft blue rim from upper left, simulating moonlight through high window
lighting.fill: very low ambient gray to preserve contrast
lighting.rim: strong blue edge light on monster and kid's raincoat
lighting.practical: doorway_light provides warm pool on floor

effects.bloom: 0.3 on practical light and monster's eyes
effects.depth_of_field: f/5.6, focused on monster, kid slightly soft on approach

animation_beats.action: kid walks into frame from right, monster hidden and still
kid passes midpoint, monster begins to rise slightly, eye widening
monster lunges forward with playful roar, kid jumps and turns in surprise
